observed_gap.trigger: Add a Palette element while a locked container is selected, or select a leaf whose direct parent is locked.
observed_gap.before: The insertion resolver accepted the locked container as a destination and element.add allowed direct child insertion.
observed_gap.impact: The editor's lock affordance could be bypassed through Palette insertion, changing a locked node's child list.

implementation.behavior: A locked selected container is not an insertion parent. The resolver bubbles the insertion anchor until it can insert immediately after the locked subtree under an unlocked container. element.add independently rejects a locked destination parent.
implementation.page_model: Locked node and its children remain unchanged; unlocked sibling order is explicit and undoable.
implementation.save_publish: Save remains draft-only; Publish stays explicit and separate.

open_source_review.review: Collection-based insertion architecture and license were reviewed in the earlier 77.44.7.A insertion-flow slice. Its Page Model-incompatible implementation is not copied; this change uses the existing native child index and command API.

assertions: Container append and selected-leaf sibling position remain correct.
Direct element.add to a locked parent throws without mutating the document.
Palette insertion after a locked container preserves its child list and supports Undo.
Canvas insertion follows normal flow without overlap.
Locked container and descendants remain unchanged after Palette insertion.
Save persists a draft and does not publish it.
